name: Orgo live state (computer list per Orgo account)

knobs.note: Read by bin/orgo-state.sh as ${ORGO_STATE_CALL_TIMEOUT_S:-30}: curl -m for each Orgo GET /computers call (one per Orgo account in catalog/orgo-plans.json). A value that is not a positive integer is refused with one ALERTS line and no account is read (never clamped).
